remind.title: Want Valiz to remind you?
remind.text: We'll notify you when online check-in opens and 3 hours before your flight.

held.title: Your price is locked!
held.text: Your reservation is awaiting payment. Pay by {date} and your ticket will be issued.
held.guaranteed: The price won't change during this time.
held.notGuaranteed: Your seat is reserved, but the price may change until you pay.
held.expiredText: The payment deadline for this reservation has passed. Search again to book at current prices.

errors.priceChanged: The price changed: the new total is {price}. Search again to continue at the current price.
errors.failed: We couldn't complete the payment right now; please try again shortly.
errors.live: Payments aren't connected yet, so we can't take payment for now.

manage.title: Manage booking
manage.noRefund: This ticket is non-refundable; you won't get money back if you cancel.
manage.holdNote: Nothing has been paid yet; the reservation is cancelled free of charge.

refundTo.original_form_of_payment: The refund goes back to your payment method.
refundTo.balance: The refund goes back to your payment method.
refundTo.airline_credits: The refund is given as airline credit.
refundTo.voucher: The refund is given as a voucher.

errors.failed: We couldn't cancel right now; please try again shortly.
errors.live: Cancellation isn't possible until payments are connected; please contact us.
errors.notFound: This booking wasn't found or is already cancelled.

plan.title: Trip plan
plan.note: This document is not an e-ticket; it's your trip plan. You'll get your boarding pass from the airline after check-in.

addBags.title: Add baggage
addBags.choose: Choose the baggage to add. Prices are the airline's current prices.

errors.failed: We couldn't add baggage right now; please try again shortly.
errors.live: Baggage can't be added until payments are connected.
errors.unavailable: Baggage can't be added to this booking right now.

change.title: Change flight
change.notAllowed: This ticket can't be changed (airline fare rule).
change.feeKnown: The airline's change fee is {price}; if the new flight costs more, the fare difference is added.
change.feeFree: Changes are free on this ticket; if the new flight costs more, you only pay the fare difference.
change.feeUnknown: The cost comes from the airline once you pick a new date (change fee + any fare difference).
change.note: Amounts are the airline's change fee and fare difference, for all passengers together.
change.done: Your flight has been changed. The new times are above.

errors.failed: The change couldn't be made right now; please try again shortly.
errors.live: Changes aren't possible until payments are connected; please contact us.
errors.notFound: This booking wasn't found, was cancelled or isn't paid yet.
errors.invalid: Check the dates: they can't be in the past and the return can't be before the outbound.
errors.none: The airline offered no change options for this date; try another day.
errors.priceChanged: The amount changed: it's now {price}. Show the options again.
